# Correction: the stored sample does not supply full replay state

| supplied input | observed coverage |
|---|---|
| launch records | 2956; metadata, creator, slot, signature and block time only |
| launch records with room reserve, last-trade, volume-bucket, status or pool state | 0 |
| copy-time historical snapshots | 100 sampled copies |
| historical member-curve reads | 420; 219 confirmed trades, 155 non-trade signatures, 46 without a signature |
| population account snapshots | 300, read 4605 seconds after the last sampled launch |

The launch window reaches beyond the grace period, but its duration does not supply the missing reserve/last-trade histories, complete trade-volume events, or graduated-pool checkpoint history. The sampled historical reads are isolated snapshots, not a state stream for every room and decision. Post-window account snapshots cannot be used as historical state at launch time.

The earlier full-sample text/image replays explicitly treated every room as live. Their zero reserve placeholders are not observations. Turning off the volume floor alone cannot turn those runs into a measured full-gate replay. The room/door market also differs from the observed independent pump curves: aggregating their trade flows would require an explicitly specified proxy, not a claim of observed production room state.

Consequently neither a measured full-gate precision/recall pair nor the full-sample routing-recall loss/recovery count for grace shortening can be obtained from these stored inputs alone. The existing age coverage and isolated gate-proxy measurements remain distinct quantities. Additional historical observations for the same launches would not be a new launch sample, but any pump-to-room mapping must be disclosed.

The earlier headline retained an obsolete claim of full sampled gate retention from the earlier grace setting. This revision replaces the headline with the explicit unmeasured status and separates conditional proxy bounds from production claims.

The owner acknowledged this conflict and authorized reporting the gaps and available bounds, while completing text-only v1 and the label-dependency notes. No production precision/recall pair is substituted with an all-live benchmark or a proxy point estimate.
